A '''ritual''', the name of which lost to history, was practiced by the ancient spirit healers on [[Voss]].

==Description==
This ritual was forbidden, locked away within the [[Shrine of Healing]] and guarded by a [[Force ghost/Legends|Voss apparition]]. The ritual was believed to be powerful enough to restore even the most fractured mind, and involved [[dream-walking]] alongside a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]]. By uniting both [[Voss (species)|Voss]] and Gormak, it could heal the mind of its "nightmares" by using a strange crystal called a [[dream-rock]] that was visible only when person was dream-walking and required another person to use it. The rock was used to turn nightmares to flesh in the [[Spirit World]] so they became tangible and possible to defeat. By defeating these tangible nightmares, a person gained control over them and, by extension, his own mind. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] used this ritual with the help of Gormak shaman [[Hadrik]] to gain control over the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] spirits they bound to themselves through the use of the Force-walking ritual.
